mapper.select: SELECT FROM appointment_order WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM appointment_order WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM appointment_order WHERE ORDER BY service_date DESC, slot_start_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_order SET status='CONFIRMED', confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING_CONFIRM' AND confirm_deadline >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE appointment_order SET status='CANCELLED', cancelled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), cancel_reason=#{reason}, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRM','CONFIRMED') AND (status='CONFIRMED' OR confirm_deadline >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND #{cancelCutoff} > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE appointment_order SET status='EXPIRED', expired_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING_CONFIRM' AND confirm_deadline <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM appointment_order WHERE status='PENDING_CONFIRM' AND confirm_deadline <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY confirm_deadline,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_order SET qr_nonce_hash=#{hash},qr_expires_at=#{expiresAt}, qr_key_id=#{keyId},version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='CONFIRMED'

UPDATE appointment_order SET queue_ticket_id=#{ticketId},version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND checkin_claim_id=#{claimId} AND status IN ('CHECKED_IN','SERVING','COMPLETED','NO_SHOW') AND queue_ticket_id IS NULL
